name: Gitleaks
description: Installs the Gitleaks secrets scanner from its checksum-verified GitHub release archive, for parity with pipelines that still run it; new setups should prefer the betterleaks feature.

version.description: Gitleaks version to install: 'latest', or a release such as 8.30.1 (a leading 'v' is accepted; 8.2.0 or later).
